name: gsk_family
description: A verified hybrid C++/MATLAB toolkit for the Gaining-Sharing Knowledge (GSK) optimizer family. It packages seven GSK-family MATLAB optimizers (GSK, AGSK, APGSK, ATMALS-GSK, eGSK, FDB-AGSK, DT-GSK) with standalone, dependency-free C++20 ports of five CEC benchmark suites (CEC2011, CEC2013, CEC2013LSGO, CEC2017, CEC2020). An optional MEX bridge lets the MATLAB optimizers evaluate the exact compiled C++ benchmarks, and every experiment run is automatically verified against the matching optimizer's published reference table.
runtimePlatform: MATLAB R2025b (optional, for the optimizers and the MEX bridge)
softwareRequirements: A C++20-capable compiler (developed with WinLibs MinGW-w64 GCC 16.1)
MATLAB R2025b (optional: required only for the GSK-family optimizers and the gskcec_eval MEX bridge)
